result.requirement: The system shall generate actionable quality improvement alerts when aggregated feedback data indicates systemic operational weaknesses.
result.business_need: The business needs to proactively identify and address recurring service failures to maintain partner trust and operational efficiency.
functional_behaviour: The system shall analyze qualitative ratings and comments from Feedback Records to detect recurring negative patterns.
The system shall automatically generate an alert when a specific issue type exceeds a defined frequency threshold within a set time window.
The system shall categorize the generated alert by operational domain such as product quality, packaging, or agent behavior.
The system shall route the alert to the Fulfillment Supervisor for immediate review and action planning.
The system shall update the Feedback Record status to indicate that the issue has been flagged for systemic review.
related_information_requirements: Aggregated frequency of specific negative feedback keywords
Operational domain classification of the issue
Current resolution status of the feedback record
business_rules: An alert is generated only if the same issue type appears in multiple Feedback Records within the defined time window.
Alerts must be categorized based on the primary sentiment of the associated textual comments.
A Feedback Record must be linked to a specific Delivery Assignment to validate the context of the quality issue.
Alerts for systemic issues must be prioritized higher than isolated single-instance feedback.

acceptance_criteria.given: Multiple Feedback Records report damaged goods for deliveries in the same zone within a week
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the aggregated data
acceptance_criteria.then: A high-priority alert is generated and routed to the Fulfillment Supervisor

acceptance_criteria.given: A single Feedback Record reports a damaged item with no other similar reports
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the isolated data
acceptance_criteria.then: No systemic quality improvement alert is generated
